title: 2027 Lexus GX Pricing, Specs, and Release Date
summary: The Lexus GX carries over into 2027 mostly unchanged, with minor upgrades across the feature lineup.
body_markdown:
The Lexus GX is a midsize SUV with serious off-road capability and seating for up to seven. Competitors include the Land Rover Defender 110, the Toyota Land Cruiser, and the Volvo XC90.

## What’s New for the 2027 Lexus GX


The Lexus GX carries over into 2027 mostly unchanged, with just minor changes to its equipment. The current GX was introduced for the 2024 model year and has seen few changes since. It’s available in a range of trim levels of varying luxury, and there's also the Overtrail off-road version.


## Design


Unlike most vehicles in the Lexus lineup, the rugged GX has a traditional body-on-frame construction. It’s closely related to the Toyota Land Cruiser but has more power and a greater emphasis on luxury inside and out. The GX and the Land Cruiser share the same boxy shape, but the Lexus has a different appearance at the front and at the rear. LED lighting, flared fenders, and an intimidating ride height all send subtle signals to the GX's intended audience.


## Powertrain


Across the lineup, the Lexus GX features a twin-turbocharged 3.4-liter V6 engine rated for 349 horsepower and 479 pound-feet of torque. That engine is complemented by a full-time four-wheel drive (4WD) system with a locking center differential and a 10-speed automatic transmission. For more impressive off-road capability, check out the Overtrail model, which features an adaptive variable suspension system, an electric locking rear differential, low-speed cruise control, hill-descent control, and 18-inch wheels with all-terrain tires. The GX is rated for up to 17 mpg combined, according to the EPA. Depending on the trim level, the GX can tow between 7,800 and 9,096 pounds when properly equipped.


## Interior


The Lexus GX seats five in its standard configuration and is available with a two-seat third row in all but the Overtrail model. That third row is snug, so this might not be the best pick for shoppers who regularly need all seven seats. Standard features include synthetic leather upholstery and heated and ventilated front seats. Available features include a heated steering wheel, heated second-row seats, ventilated second-row seats, massaging front-row seats, genuine leather upholstery, a panoramic sunroof, and rear-window sunshades. Models with the third row offer 40.2 cubic feet of storage space behind the back seats, which opens up to a maximum of 76.9 cubic feet. In two-row configurations, those numbers increase to 45.6 cubic feet and 90.5 cubic feet. A hands-free power liftgate is available.


## Technology


Standard equipment includes a 14-inch touchscreen with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity. There’s also a 12.3-inch digital driver information system, which can be configured for typical road usage as well as for more specialized SUV functions such as monitoring trailer brakes, oil temperatures, and pitch and roll. Alongside the surround-view camera system, the GX also features a multi-terrain monitor system that provides a detailed real-time view of potential obstructions when off-roading. A 21-speaker Mark Levinson audio system is optional.

## Safety


The Lexus GX comes standard with the Lexus Safety System+ 3.0 package, which includes adaptive cruise control, forward-collision warning, automatic emergency braking, pedestrian detection, lane-departure warning, lane-centering assist, lane-keep assist, and steering and braking assist. Other standard features include blind-spot monitors, rear cross-traffic alert, and front and rear parking sensors. A traffic-jam assistance feature for low-speed driving is available but requires a subscription. Neither the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration nor the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety had crash-tested the GX at the time of writing.


## Pricing and Release Date


The 2027 Lexus GX is on sale now. At the time of writing, the GX 550 Premium started at $69,085 and the GX 550 Premium+ at $73,400. The GX 550 Overtrail starts at $73,730 and the Overtrail+ at $85,010. At the top of the lineup, Luxury and Luxury+ trims start at $81,600 and $85,600, respectively. These prices include a mandatory destination charge of $1,550.
